description: WP-O5 Codex: Orks (11e) DA KRUNCH (Wurrband enhancement, Orks Psyker model; this model is equipped with Da Krunch: 24" A3 BS4+ S5 AP-1 D1 [BLAST 3] [HAZARDOUS] [LETHAL HITS] [PSYCHIC]) — passive, added by the list-build pass. Fixture ork11e_enh_wurrband: the Weirdboy carries it, Custodian Guard B ~17" away. The shooting panel lists Da Krunch; a real click on Confirm shoots it: the Game Log shows the Da Krunch attack and its hazardous roll. Setup privilege: auto wound allocation.
